Well can you guys be a little bit specific? What are you interested in my management?

Roughly I don't have any strategy. I have some points I want to follow, but they are only in my head and this is not like 3x profit means end of trading this day. My rulez are more about the feelings. My favourite T-shirt has a logo "dont think...feel" and it's because of the markets. Every day is different so maybe you can, but I can not, to write conventional rulez and than follow. I have made this last 3 years and there were only problems, that no one knows if rulez I have written are ok, even I don't know, no Idea if they making sense, if they take me on the right way. Just rulez and follow:) And this has led to problems with discipline, frustration that I can not follow any rulezz and that I'm realy dummy....BUT wait a minute....It's the same like a painter, artist... he can not have rulez to, 3cm with light yellow and than switch to blue and continue 5cm on the paper:) it's funny for me now to think about it this way, sry for that:)

I hope you understand, that by cooking your dinner you can not say "I'll put away 30% of the ham from left and 30% from right and the midle, the rest 30% I'll cook on the pan, because this is how my mom do it" Do you know this story? The husband came to his wife and ask why is she doing that and the answer was "because my mom do the same" So the husband went to the mother and ask again, Why 30+30% of the ham into the trash and cook only the rest, making no sense. The answer was again the same "because my mom do it like this" so he went to grandmother and ask again why are you doing this? And now the answer was " because I have a small pan":)

Do you understand? Everything is changing and you can not follow the way of someone else, make rulezz because you should? go to the school because you should? have a wife because you should? buy a car or house? have a daily job? blow out 60% of a ham because your parrents do it like this...

I do not like this way

So if you want to get some specific Info, please let me know have a nice day J.

Hey Jiri,

let me sum it up for you.

The trading rule is.....to not follow any rules.

Of course, each trading decision is to made on the get go. And all the confidence come from thousands of hours of screen time + practice. I believe you've done your due diligence on your own trading, and you've paid "premium" for it (just guessing). Now is the time that all those "expenses" pay off for you, and so far, I think it's in a lightning fast rate.

Good going Jiri. Keep it up!

Regards, Chao
